categories.about: Every assigned code point's general category (UnicodeData.txt), as runs "low-high:category" (hexadecimal; "low:category" for one code point), and for a letter (L*) the first word of its name, by its index in words ("41-5A:Lu:0"), as Proof names a letter's script: FontLab's Python 2.7 knows Unicode 5.2, so a proof's classes come from this table under either interpreter. A code point no run holds is unassigned.
